description: Plugins from Sumvec.ai — practical, source-anchored tools for marketing, SEO, and AI search work. Built for teams who'd rather cite the primary source than chase the hype cycle.

plugins.name: ai-search-optimization
plugins.description: Audit and optimize a webpage or site for AI search visibility — Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini. Anchored in Google's official AI optimization guide; clearly separates Google-stated rules from broader AISO/GEO industry practice. Zero external dependencies — all scripts use Python stdlib only. /aiso-audit produces Markdown + Sumvec-branded HTML, plus PDF if a Chromium-family browser is installed.
